Nina P: We ran the multi-region soak yesterday. Two follow-ups: how do we attribute costs for split-fanout requests, and what's the minimal audit surface for residency tenants?

Ravi K: Fanout case: single client request spawns 3 subcalls across regions for reranking/embeddings. Billing needs to map that many-to-one. Suggest we tag subcalls with parent_request_id + subcall_region so recon can roll-up.

Theo L: Tech note: our current logs only capture the top-level region. We'll need to enrich the tracing spans and logs with `parent_id` and `exec_region`. Also carry a `billing_stamp` computed at enqueue time.

Nina P: For residency, product requires proof the data was processed in-home region unless explicit consent for failover. So logs must include both `home_region` (from tenant profile) and `exec_region` for every data-processing event.

Ravi K: Header plan: edge populates `X-RW-Home` and `X-RW-Parent` and signs them: `X-RW-Signature: v1:base64`. Downstream services validate signature against tenant and timestamp before trusting the headers.

Theo L: To handle async workers that pick jobs from queues, encode the home/parent/billing_stamp into the task payload as metadata. Workers verify signature using a short-lived key if possible.

Comply-Bot: Compliance note: retention default 18 months for routing/audit logs, but we need retention tiers per customer contract. Also include a redaction policy: PII hashed in transit logs.

Nina P: Edge cases: manual runbook overrides (ops-forced failover) should generate an audit event and set `X-RW-Override: ops:<user>` so billing recon can tag it.

Ravi K: Reconciliation algo sketch: aggregate infra costs by region and time-window, join with enriched logs to allocate cost share per tenant by policy (home | served | hybrid). Produce daily attribution table for billing export.

Theo L: Implementation estimates: edge + signing (1w), task metadata + worker changes (1w), trace/log schema + collector changes (1w), recon job + sample queries (2w), console flag + alerts (0.5w). Parallel work across infra, runtime, and billing teams.

Nina P: Action items for RFC follow-up: 1) header names + signing spec, 2) task payload metadata contract, 3) trace/span enrichment schema, 4) recon algorithm doc + sample SQL, 5) console UI notes + override events, 6) retention tiers and redaction rules. Owners: Ravi -> recon doc, Theo -> edge/worker prototype, Nina -> RFC edit and compliance checklist.

Comply-Bot: Opened case 5012: "multi-region billing + residency audit follow-up" and attached compliance template.

Nina P: I'll post the RFC patch with examples. Quick header example to include:
```
X-RW-Home: eu-1
X-RW-Parent: req-20260322-993
X-RW-Ts: 2026-03-22T18:21:00Z
X-RW-Signature: v1:base64sig
```

Theo L: Will prototype the envoy filter today and push a small PR.

Ravi K: I'll draft the recon queries and share as a Gist for review.

Nina P: Thanks all. Ping if blockers.
